metadata.name: Krishna River centerline - Vijayawada study corridor
metadata.source: Hybrid: 5 of the 14 vertices are REAL, sourced landmark coordinates from Wikipedia/Wikidata (Prakasam Barrage, Bhavani Island, Kanakadurga Flyover, Kanaka Durga Varadhi). The remaining vertices are project-authored interpolation connecting those anchors and extending to the study-area bounding box edges - they are NOT surveyed river-centerline data.

real_anchor_points.name: Prakasam Barrage
real_anchor_points.citation: Wikipedia / Wikidata Q7238160, citing National Register of Large Dams 2019

metadata.known_limitation: This is still NOT an authoritative surveyed river-network dataset. India's National Water Data Portal (nwdp.nwic.gov.in, Ministry of Jal Shakli / CWC) publishes an official nationwide River Network GeoJSON, but the file exceeds 30MB (whole-India coverage) and could not be practically fetched/filtered in this environment. Swapping in an extracted, authoritative Krishna-only geometry later requires only replacing this file - all downstream consumers (risk engine, candidate generator) read the same GeoJSON Feature shape.
